reviews.author: Naye Silva
reviews.text: I had an excellent experience with this auto body shop. From the very beginning, everyone was kind, respectful, and professional. They repaired my car quickly and efficiently, and the final result exceeded my expectations. What really stood out to me was their honesty and fair pricing. Other shops in the area quoted me much higher prices, but they offered a very reasonable and affordable solution without compromising on quality. They were incredibly helpful during a stressful situation, and their customer service made the entire process much easier. It’s not often that you find people who genuinely care about their customers and treat them with such respect. I am truly grateful for their help and would highly recommend them to anyone looking for reliable, honest, and high-quality auto body work. Thank you again for the outstanding service!

reviews.author: Jorge Abril
reviews.text: I recently dropped of my bmw to get painted both. Bumpers front and rear to get painted and I tell you the service was amazing!! Quality overall is 100% and amazing place to do business i highly recommend!!! Thank you again.

reviews.author: Crista Booth
reviews.text: Can’t express how amazing my experience was with Lincoln auto body. They are friendly, professional, and work in a timely manner which is so important when looking for the right shop! Definitely will be returning and recommending them to family/friends.

reviews.author: Markelian Murcielago
reviews.text: Dropped off my “fiberglass front bumper” off to get painted & installed, paid $750 and was told yea we can do it we’ll do our best !! 1 week after driving the car, bumper was hanging on drivers side. Dropped it off again for a whole week to get it fixed and picked it up with a 2 inch noticeable gap from the headlight !! I told Luis i wasn’t happy at all i’m gona have to take it to another shop & his answer was “yea thats the best we can do” I’ve probably sent around 10 clients his way over the years but was treated like a nobody!! Never will i go back to this shop

reviews.author: Aylin Cruz
reviews.text: Very honest mechanic. He helped me with my truck and did a perfect job. I had an accident and he fixed the car like nothing happened. He was very responsive and answered all my questions at all time in a timely and professional manner. I posted photos of before and after.

reviews.author: Victor Savreski
reviews.text: I strongly recommend Lincoln Auto Body. I brought my car in for repairs on my front bumper and was extremely impressed. Luis was courteous, professional, and very responsive throughout the process. The team worked efficiently and returned my car in excellent, like-new condition. I couldn’t be more satisfied with the results, thank you!

reviews.author: Rebecca Reisen
reviews.text: This place goes above and beyond! Louis was professional, fair, fast, friendly, and communicative. I’m so happy to find someone I can trust! Recommending this shop to everyone I know - this is the spot to go to for anything bodywork!

reviews.author: Neil Gordon
reviews.text: Luis and his team did *phenomenal* work on my car. Luis was transparent throughout the process, clearly articulating the costs behind the estimate as well as well as several options to try bring down the costs. As it turns out, Luis provided the best of 5 other estimates from other body shops. But my decision to use Lincoln Auto was more about Luis - his honesty, sincerity, and genuineness. Throughout the process, I felt that Luis was doing his best to fit my schedule, not his (my car was ready earlier than expected!). I *highly* recommend Lincoln Auto!

reviews.author: Melanie Candiano
reviews.text: My sister brought her car a couple years ago, and I don’t have pictures of that. I do have a before and after of my boyfriend’s car. Amazing job for an amazing price. They even helped us lower our deductible, and for that I am extremely thankful. They also fixed a minor issue that wasn’t even apart of the accident. I plan on bringing my car here in the future because it needs some work done too. 5 stars, 10/10 recommend. :)

reviews.author: Ayari Pardo
reviews.text: In February of this year, my car stolen. The damage was extensive: the bumper was broken, the ignition was pulled apart, and the window was shattered. Luis, the owner of the body shop, was incredibly helpful and insightful throughout the entire process. From the moment I brought my car in, Luis took charge and ensured that everything was handled smoothly. He maintained constant communication with my adjuster and kept me updated on the progress, which made the entire experience much less stressful. When I saw the end result, I was amazed. I couldn't believe it was the same car. The quality of the work was outstanding, and it was clear that the entire staff took great pride in their craftsmanship. Everyone I interacted with was respectful and knowledgeable, making me feel confident in their abilities. I highly recommend this body shop to anyone in need of repairs. The level of service and expertise provided by Luis and his team is exceptional. They even provided a little gift! I would give them a tenfold recommendation without hesitation.

reviews.author: Sokol Kadare
reviews.text: I got my car Honda CRV 2018 in a accident. Luis and its crew did an absolutely amazing job on making my car look better than showroom new. The people that work there are extremely helpful and professional. They made the entire experience seamless. If you ever need any body shop service, quick and easy, Lincoln Auto Body is the only place I would bring my cars to in the future!

reviews.author: Kate Celestino
reviews.text: I highly recommend Lincoln Auto Body. I brought my car in to repair the fender from damage in a hit-and-run accident. Luis was professional, responsive and polite. His team worked quickly to restore my car back to pristine condition. I couldn’t be happier. Thank you!

reviews.author: Brent Nickles
reviews.text: My car is super clean! Inside and outside. Not only did Luiz and his team fix my 2023 Tesla Model Y door and bumper perfectly, they also did it way quicker than I expected and sent me away with a fresh and shiny car. These guys clearly take pride in their work and the process from start to finish was seamless and well communicated. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Josayris Nin
reviews.text: I got the hood of my car replaced here and the service was fantastic! Luis was kind, helpful, and informative. The turnaround time for the work was quick and easy. Highly recommend this shop!

reviews.author: Maya Pyrzanowski
reviews.text: I had a great experience with Lincoln Auto Body. Luis was very informative, nice and efficient throughout the whole process. Francisco was also very pleasant to speak with when dropping off my car. They made my time during this easy and stress free, keeping me updated on the progress. They finished the job in less than a week and when I picked my car up, she looked brand new. Shiny and perfect! I will definitely continue to come to them whenever I need work done to my car. The price was also very fair and made me feel at ease. They are the best! Definitely come here if you want an easy-going and efficient experience.

reviews.author: Marianne Johnson
reviews.text: Luis and his team at Lincoln AutoBody are amazing! I recently got into a fender bender and needed a new bumper. Luis took the time to walk me through everything and made the entire process as smooth as can be. I was recommended to go there because of their honesty and quality of work - and they definitely delivered.

reviews.author: Jessica Coyotl
reviews.text: My friend recommended me this shop and honestly I had a great experience with Lincoln auto body. Luis is very responsive and kept in contact with me through the whole process. Luis and his team did such an amazing job at getting my car looking good as new. They even helped me lower my deductible which I am very grateful for. I highly recommend this shop to anyone. You will not be disappointed! Thanks again to the team

reviews.author: milena fo
reviews.text: you will not find better mechanics in the area. as a first time car owner i cannot begin to express how much it means to me to find honest and reliable mechanics that i can trust, truly the best in the business, thank you guys so much.

reviews.author: Neysa Lomax
reviews.text: Francisco and his team are an amazing team! I brought my car in to have some works done and he was honest and fair in pricing. I will only be using his auto body going forward. Thank you so much for the great work!

reviews.author: Sergio Rodriguez
reviews.text: Super good customer service and they do a very well job at what they’re supposed to do, I recommend this body shop.

reviews.author: Richard Hampson
reviews.text: Lincoln Auto Body did an outstanding job repairing the damage on my Honda Civic. Luis and Francisco provided excellent customer service, and completed the work within two weeks of me dropping my car off. They provided me with updates on the progress of the fix when I reached out, and always answered or returned my phone calls immediately. In my experience with auto body shops, this was by far the fastest turnaround time I’ve experienced before and also by far the best level of communication and customer service I received. I highly recommend Lincoln Auto Body.

reviews.author: Dominick
reviews.text: I can't say enough good things about Luis ! My son hit a seemingly prehistoric raccoon on the back roads at night in NJ. I searched the top rated body shops in the area and found a couple. Luis was the only one who answered. He worked with me, listened and answered every time. (Trust me I can talk to lol.) The shop is not the biggest but these guys are craftsman and do great work. I'm very picky and usually have to do something over or correct something. This was not the case with Lincoln Auto Body. I looked at the end result and smiled ! I drove from Staten Island to have the car fixed here because of how on the ball Luis was. (My son came back home) Even living in Staten Island and having a friend here who manages one of the biggest shops on the island, I would bring all my future work to Luis and Lincoln auto body. That should say it all !! Thank you to Luis and the staff at Lincoln !

reviews.author: Alexandra Jaworski
reviews.text: My family and I have been going here for years. Louis always does a great job! Fantastic quality for a fair price. He’s great at communication and works with your schedule. From fixing both body and bumper damage to matching specialized paint, Lincoln Auto Body is a reliable quality shop. He has provided the same level of quality on my Mazda as he did my Honda car. Very well versed!

reviews.author: Jasmine O
reviews.text: Lincoln auto body recently did repairs to my 2010 jeep patriot after an accident and they were great from start to finish. They picked my car up, helped me with the insurance claim as I was having trouble navigating that process and helped me get my rental. Luis kept in contact with me through the whole process so I knew what was being done as it was being done. The great customer service really helped put me at ease at such a stressful moment.

reviews.author: Vincent Ginefra
reviews.text: Luis is amazing!! I couldn’t recommend him and his crew highly enough. I had a lot of issues with my car, the dealership, and the brand trying to get reimbursed for a car issue that was a product and dealership mishap, and Luis took care of all of the comms with them and the car came out of his shop looking just like it did when I bought it brand new. 10/10 would recommend!

reviews.author: Cynthia Dewhart
reviews.text: Lincoln Auto Body always does a more than awesome job! Every time I’ve needed their services , I am 100% satisfied on the outcome! They know the how to get the job done and will bring your car back to life! I’ve been coming here for years and feel secure that my car is in good hands! Thanks to Luis and his team for all their hard work!

reviews.author: Susana
reviews.text: When I was looking around for a body shop to fix my electric vehicle, I called around and was specifically recommended Lincoln Body shop by the dealership. From the very beginning, not only was Luis super responsive, but he truly went about and beyond helping me get in touch with THE most impossible insurance company to work with (Sedgwick) and even gave me tips related to renting a vehicle as I was not very familiar with the whole process. Luis kept my updated on anything new during this lengthy process, and was always patient, professional, and courteous. His work spoke for itself, and my car is looking like it came fresh from the manufacturer. All I have to say is many thanks because if I ever need anything else car related, I have my go-to person.

reviews.author: Neela Rustam
reviews.text: Luis and his team are amazing! They are helpful, care about the service, and quality of work they provide. I’ve trusted both of my vehicles to their care and highly recommend Lincoln Auto Body to anyone looking for people they can trust and rely on to get the job done.

reviews.author: Marc Simone
reviews.text: Louis and his team are amazing! I have a 2012 Honda Pilot that was in an accident They repaired my car in less then 2 days and it looks brand new! Louis was very nice to work with and has a great personallity! I would recommend his shop to all my friends and family!

reviews.author: Sidney
reviews.text: I went to Lincoln Auto Body without an appointment on a Thursday, dropped it off Friday and picked it up the next day. They work quickly and efficiently and also we’re very kind in helping fix my front bumper within a short time frame. I recommend them to anyone needing auto body repairs.

reviews.author: sarah
reviews.text: Amazing job on my car and awesome team to work with. I will continue to come back for any auto body service needed. Luis is awesome!

reviews.author: Ramki Sankar
reviews.text: Lincoln Autobody team is phenomenal...they understand your need, timeframe and work with you. I visited several times for 3 of my cars and all were taken care well. I highly recommend their service!

reviews.author: Matthew Mateen Sherzoy
reviews.text: Lincoln Autobody exceeded all my expectations! Their reasonable prices, attention to detail, quick turnaround, and top-notch customer service made the entire repair process stress-free. My car looks brand new, and I couldn't be happier with the results. Highly recommend Lincoln Autobody for anyone needing quality repairs!

reviews.author: Robert Mercurio
reviews.text: We have brought multiple cars to Lincoln Auto Body for repairs. Luis and his staff are always professional and courteous and do a great job. We highly recommend them for any auto body work.

reviews.author: Jaclyn
reviews.text: Luis and his team do such a great job with their work! Both times I've taken my car here I couldn't have been any happier with the work. Great customer service and great prices. Highly recommend them

reviews.author: Julia Dolan
reviews.text: Luis and his team are friendly, honest, and easy to work with. They handle all insurance related issues, which is a HUGE help. Their work is EXCEPTIONAL! They had my Lexus looking NEW in no time!

reviews.author: Minire Saitoski
reviews.text: I was referred to Lincoln auto body and I was nervous to get my new 2021 5 series BMW repaired anywhere. I looked up his reviews and decided to give him my car . They were very patient with all my questions and concerns and I received many updates. I’m happy to support this family run business and I applaud their customer service, thank you for a great job , I’m hoping to never need you for a collision again and I’m happy to refer you to family and friends :)

reviews.author: Penn Room
reviews.text: I had such a great experience at Lincoln Auto Body! After being given the run around on timeline and pricing at a few other shops, it was refreshing to deal with Luis who gave a fair price and was crystal clear on when my car would be ready. The cherry on top is that obviously high quality products were used because my car looks absolutely fantastic and there is no visible difference between the part that was painted and the rest of the car. If you are researching auto body shops in the area, please go here - You will not regret it! Thank you, Luis!

reviews.author: giselle farrell
reviews.text: I came to Lincoln Auto after I had a prior bad paint job done on my vehicle. Everyone at Lincoln auto was so helpful and affordable!! They got my car repainted and blended seamlessly into the original paint color. I was extremely impressed!!! I highly recommend this auto body shop, and their prices are so reasonable!!!

reviews.author: Brian Cronk
reviews.text: Not many shops will repair body rust. When I spoke to Luis he was willing to take on the work. His shop did the repair correctly and there is no sign of rust left. I appreciate his meticulousness to my vehicle given the scope of repairs. They even gave the car a good wash and cleaning afterwards. Would definitely recommend Lincoln Auto body for a thorough and perfect repair.

reviews.author: Kaitlin Olcott Dzevel
reviews.text: Luis & Lincoln Auto Body are fantastic and I highly recommend them. I took my car to Lincoln to have my hood replaced & painted due to rust & peeling. They did a great job, on-time, and for a very reasonable price.

reviews.author: Jessica Cordova
reviews.text: My experience at Lincoln auto was very professional. The Lincoln auto team truly does care. The service provided to my car was done in a timely manner and the results were beautiful! I recommend Lincoln auto to anybody. I was more than satisfied with my experience here!

reviews.author: Courtney L
reviews.text: I visited Lincoln Auto Body Garfield after reading their Google reviews and they did not disappoint. Luis and his crew were friendly and professional. Their prices are some of the best in the area and I got my car back sooner than they estimated! I'm very satisfied with the work they did on my car and I will be recommending their shop to my friends and family

reviews.author: Christine Walsh
reviews.text: I was in a minor car accident and needed to get the car fixed. My mother referred me here. Louis and his team were helpful and knowledgable through the whole process. He explained what he would be doing to the car and gave me a fair estimate. The service was taken care of in a timely manner. I would HIGHLY RECOMMEND using Lincoln Auto Body to anyone who needs any service or repair to their vehicle.

reviews.author: Constructive
reviews.text: We brought in a car that needed a front bumper as well as a panel on each side to be painted (in a metallic factory original paint). The Lincoln Autobody team did such a great job, three sides of this car were painted and blended so well it looks just like the day I picked it up from the deal. Excellent work at a very fair price.

reviews.author: Dennis Bonagura
reviews.text: If you are looking to have work completed on your auto and you want someone who does great work and is trustworthy, Lincoln Auto Body is the only place where you can have that peace of mind! Give them a try. Luis is the most professional and customer oriented business owner I have ever met and his craftsmanship is exceptional. Lincoln Auto Body is the only place I will bring my cars and recommend.

reviews.author: Nancy J Huffman
reviews.text: Lincoln Auto Body was nothing but professional! My car looked like new when they were finished. The staff is extremely knowledgeable which made me feel that I made the right decision by choosing them. I Would definitely recommend them!

reviews.author: Tara Domke
reviews.text: Lincoln Auto Body is a small family business that is extremely caring, personable, and thorough. I was referred to them through a church friend almost 3 years ago and have been relying on them ever since! They are honest and very helpful. Even when I have issues that they don’t handle, they refer me to good, trustworthy people who have never steered me wrong. I have never been so blessed to have such reliable people in my life. They truly value their customers and welcome people with the most amazing care. So much care in fact, that I feel comfortable enough to say they are more like close friends/extended family. I am forever grateful for them! Thank you for everything!

reviews.author: Nathalie Brantley
reviews.text: GREAT PEOPLE + GREAT WORK! I am not one to usually , but I was so pleased with my experience that I couldn't help but share it with the world. I 100% recommend this auto body shop for all of your repairs. Luis and his team are professionals that will delivery quality work and NOT overcharge you or take advantage of your lack of knowledge of cars.

reviews.author: Jazebell Cisneros
reviews.text: Luis is very friendly. They do an amazing job! Replaced and painted my front bumper. Color matching was on point! The best auto body shop ever

reviews.author: Ivan Mikhaylishin
reviews.text: Got into an accident couple of months ago. Had it towed to this mechanic show and Luis took care of everything else. Was a little not sure if the car would drive the same after it would get fixed but they did a awesome job. You can't even tell that it had been in an accident. They do an awesome job would definitely recommend them.

reviews.author: Sarita Rowner
reviews.text: I had the best experience. They picked up my car and dropped it off…. It was done quickly at an amazing price compared to other body shops I visited. My car looks brand new and I could not be happier. I would definitely recommend this body shop.

reviews.author: Emily
reviews.text: Hands down the best auto shop around. The staff is super friendly, knowledgeable & experts in their craft. Not only do they accommodate you in a timely fashion but the quality of work is top tier. It’s truly an unmatched service at the best price.

reviews.author: Yasemin Eriskin
reviews.text: I agonized over finding an auto body shop that could fix some scratches / dents for my leased car - I finally chose Lincoln Auto Body based on reviews and couldn't be happier! We stopped by for a quote one day, dropped it off a different day and had it back within a few days. Luis was wonderful and the car looks like nothing ever happened!

reviews.author: Jenna LaPietra
reviews.text: Lincoln Auto Body took great care of my husband and me when we brought our BMW in for body repair work after an accident. They did a beautiful job on the car. On time and for the price that they quoted. The car took just a few days and they were extremely easy to deal with and to reach. I would HIGHLY recommend them to anyone. I hope that we don't need their services in the future but if I did, I would absolutely use them again, in fact, my husband will be bringing his Porsche in for some minor body work as well. We are extremely appreciative of their work and their business practices.

reviews.author: Kimberly Monroy
reviews.text: Extremely happy with the process. Being that it was my first time in a car accident and didn't know what to do, Luis went above and beyond to help me sort out everything with the insurance. He was constantly following up with me to make sure I was sending them the necessary paperwork to get the process started. Once they started working on my car, he kept me updated on the progress. My car looks amazing, as if nothing ever happened to it. I couldn't be happier with them.

reviews.author: Faran Abbasi
reviews.text: I have brought mine and a few family members vehicles here for body work since i found this shop a few years ago. Any work the guys do always comes out looking really good. Luis is nice and has been more than fair with us on any price he gives. Definitely worth it to go there.

reviews.author: Alexandra Garces
reviews.text: Great service! Luis went above and beyond fixing my car and the results were amazing! The price was reasonable and my car was fixed in less time that I expected. I would highly recommend this auto body shop!

reviews.author: Stephanie Carvajal
reviews.text: My car was hit passenger side. It was going to need a whole new door , rear bumper & quarter panel as well as a whole new paint job on the passenger side from bumper to bumper. They made sure my worries & fear of my car not looking the same again were diminished. When I tell you my car came back & looked better then when I bought it , I was stunned. Def. recommend coming here to get any auto body work done. Officially have a team I can trust & will come to for any future auto work needs I may have. Can't thank Luis & his team enough.

reviews.author: Anubhav Choudhury
reviews.text: This is a team you can trust. My car's passenger door was damaged and had to be changed. Luis and his team were exceptional in handling the issue while following up with the insurance at the same time. Definitely coming back here and refering friends for any body work that is needed.

reviews.author: Kayla O'Neill
reviews.text: Luis and his team did a great job fixing my Fusion! A deer ran into the driver side door and left a bunch of dents all along the left side of the car in addition to breaking the side view mirror. Lincoln autobody replaced the necessary parts and now my car looks good as new!

reviews.author: Laura Cinquino
reviews.text: My new go-to for all things auto body related! The owner is responsive and so easy to work with. They go above and beyond to make sure you're happy, and that your experience is a positive one. So glad that I found this place!

reviews.author: Andre McNeil
reviews.text: I had an exceptional experience at Lincoln Auto Body. It looks as if nothing happened to my car at all. They kept me informed throughout the process and I got my car back very quickly.

reviews.author: Ikrash Khan
reviews.text: my third time here getting parts painted, and each time is better than the last. Quality is always A+ and the price is always fair/better than other places. This is the only paint shop I would recommend to anyone.

reviews.author: Dmen Mendez
reviews.text: Awesome work fix my 2021 black ram truck. Can never tell I damage my tailbed great work. Fast and Luis is great, and price the best around thank you.

reviews.author: Alicia Zen
reviews.text: I had a freak leak from the left passenger door; both tail lights would hold water, then leak into my trunk when it rained. Luis & his team fixed my car three weeks ago. I checked my car today; after the crazy rains we had last night & everything was bone dry. I can't thank them enough for relieving my stress whenever it rains.

reviews.author: Jim Baker
reviews.text: I got my car waxed and they took all the scratches out. Looks amazing and was done same day for a very fair price. Great work Luis and team!

reviews.author: Colleen Justiniano
reviews.text: Great work, great communication -and they gave us the car back when promised. Would definitely recommend.

reviews.author: Tanya Greene
reviews.text: What an ordeal! DO NOT ALLOW DAVID'S TOW COMPANY to tow your vehicle. Shame on the Lodi Police for allowing me to be manipulated into their service. Short version....They picked up my truck from an accident on yesterday and to date I do not know where my vehicle is. They have yet to tow it where it is supposed to go. David's Tow MADE A TERRIBLE AND UNFORTUNATE MISHAP WORSE THAN IT EVER HAD TO BE

reviews.author: Amanda DelRios
reviews.text: Great experience, the owner is super nice and gave me a reasonable price for when I got into a car accident and needed my bumper fixed and helped put on parts and work around parts that I ordered wrong. He was patient for when I needed to pay too.

reviews.author: Shoba Prabhakar
reviews.text: I had my car repaired at this place and they did an excellent job. I even recommended this place to all my co workers and they all have only good things to say about this place. The owner and their team is amazing.

reviews.author: Amanda Mastropasqua
reviews.text: Luis fixed my car quickly & efficiently! The price was great & he really worked some magic to fix it! I highly recommend this auto body shop!

reviews.author: john meyer
reviews.text: I was referred to Luis by an old friend and I dropped my car off the day before I had to trade in my car . His work was amazing not only that the car was done at exactly the time he told me it was gonna be done by I have two other cars to bring to him and he will surely be getting my business from here on out ..Thanx Luis youre the man !!!!

reviews.author: philip ganci
reviews.text: Myself and every one of my friends and relatives I send to Lincoln Auto Body gets treated like a KING! The work is top notch and Luis ( the Manager) works with you!

reviews.author: Kelly Zampino
reviews.text: I highly recommend Lincoln Auto Body. Luis and his team are responsive, honest, and do exceptional work.

reviews.author: Atdhe Dervishaj
reviews.text: I just finished having both my cars services here couldnt he happier with the results i will definetly only be bringin my car here from now on the paintjob looks even better than oem.

reviews.author: Karla Ramirez
reviews.text: Luis was extremely helpful and accommodating. Reasonable pricing, top quality service, and overall one happy customer! Will definitely be returning to this facility.

reviews.author: Paul Schmucker Mission Life Honduras
reviews.text: Fantastic work! On time! Followed through on every detail. Had front bumper painted. Super job! Super staff! Honest and perfect work. Thanks guys!

reviews.author: Ramon Ortega
reviews.text: The other day I stopped by the shop to ask for an estimate on a few damages done on my car and Luis who was attending me at the time was very rude and unprofessional he excessively raised his voice and told me I have no time for you this is a waste of my time. I was shocked by how rude he was I will not recommend him to anyone at all!!!!!

reviews.author: Carlos Velez
reviews.text: We have being going to them for MANY years and they never let us down, the quality of work has been exceptional... we've taken our Acura, Lexus,Toyota and Jeep!!!

reviews.author: Diana Coss
reviews.text: Great experience! Work done to my Vehicle was amazing! It was done fast and perfect! Repeat customer for life here!

reviews.author: Ivan Angeles
reviews.text: Amazing staff & very reasonable when it comes to $$$. The quality of work they do speaks for itself in the results. My go to spot if I ever have an unfortunate incident again.

reviews.author: Glenn Oneill
reviews.text: Louise and the crew are simply the best . Both kids learned to drive on the same car and it looks like new thanks to Lincoln

reviews.author: Daniela Valencia
reviews.text: I took my car to this place EXCELLENT WORK AND PEOPLE. Reasonable prices Mr. Luis help us a lot with everything I Recommend this place!! :D

reviews.author: BNY Products
reviews.text: just got my. car. back. nice. job. great price. they. matched. my. pearl. white really nice. very. friendly.

reviews.author: Freicy
reviews.text: Luis was very helpful and helped me along the process very nice guy and an extremely professional crew. I highly recommend this place for anyone Thank you Luis!!

reviews.author: nancy tavarez
reviews.text: Very quick and efficient, prices very good and turn-around was excellent, was very happy with the body work. Thank you

reviews.author: Lobo Ashqui
reviews.text: Thank you so much, Lincoln Auto Body. It was a great experience. They were very attentive in scheduling the car repair appointment and provided excellent, friendly service. The repair price was reasonable. Completely reliable.

reviews.author: Sergio Rodriguez
reviews.text: Excellent work! Fast and very reasonably priced. They helped me with my insurance and I was very happy. Thank you, I highly recommend them.
